fact: On 27 Tir 2017 E.C. (5 February 2025) the Ethiopian Statistics Service released the 2015 E.C. Statistical Abstract in print and on its website, compiled from administrative records of various institutions (the text names no individual record-holders), the Director General stating that administrative records are one of the Service's data sources.
title: ዓመታዊ የስታቲስቲክስ መጽሔት ለተጠቃሚዎች ይፋ ተደረገ
